usage_in_this_project: Offline high-fidelity teacher/reference model; not called by the online EnKF default.
notes: The project adapter applies process-local NumPy compatibility shims for the legacy PyFrac code.
Snapshot mode initializes a PyFrac Cartesian mesh from a PKN state; native mode is an explicit time-marching experiment.
PyFrac does not provide native proppant transport for this integration; sand remains an external observation/constraint.
